s1.text: Yes, 0 is rational. A rational number can be written as p/q with p and q integers and q not 0. 0 = 0/1, so it fits. An irrational number like sqrt 2 cannot be written as p/q; its decimal 1.41421... never ends or repeats, but 0 is exact.

s2.text: 0 is not rational because it is nothing, so it cannot be a fraction. It is the same as sqrt 2.
Between 2 and 3 there are no rational numbers, only 2 and 3.
7/8 terminates because 7 and 8 are big numbers and 1/3 repeats because 1 is small.
